description: Source code implementing parsing and validation functions for X.509 certificates, including parsing of certificate structure, extensions, and related components, based on RFC 5280.

classes.name: ParsedTbsCertificate
classes.description: Structure holding parsed components of a TBSCertificate.

classes.name: ParsedDistributionPoint
classes.description: Structure representing a parsed distribution point in CRL/OCSP extensions.

classes.name: ParsedExtension
classes.description: Structure representing a parsed X.509 extension.

methods.name: ParseCertificate
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded X.509 certificate, extracting main components and errors.

methods.name: ParseTbsCertificate
methods.description: Parses the TBSCertificate part of an X.509 certificate.

methods.name: ParseExtension
methods.description: Parses a single extension from its DER encoding.

methods.name: ParseExtensions
methods.description: Parses a sequence of extensions into a map.

methods.name: ConsumeExtension
methods.description: Retrieves and removes a specific extension by OID from a map of extensions.

methods.name: ParseAuthorityInfoAccessURIs
methods.description: Extracts URIs from Authority Information Access extension.

methods.name: VerifySerialNumber
methods.description: Validates the serial number of a certificate according to RFC 5280 rules.
